digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program and infrastructure hardening
propositions: Bug provenance must be captured at creation and queryable via metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must block raw git writes, unread config fields, unchecked wall-clock assertions, incomplete AC checkboxes, stale code comments, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python following the strangler-fig pattern.
Explicit review-plan invocation on bugs must trigger a real review, with Gerrit enforcement blocking oversized bug fixes without one.
Declared field asymmetries in the reconciler transport must be pinned by property tests and pagination must be deduplicated into shared iterators.
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression prevention.
